sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team, released in 2024 as part of the Qwen2.5 series. The model contains 3 billion parameters and is optimized for conversational and text-generation tasks.
